stories.title: Night Plane review – join the jumbo jet to hell in this indie horror head trip
summary: Liquid Static Studio; PCYou take on the role of flight attendant in this clever and absorbing retro-style game that veers from daft horror spoof to genuinely disturbingThere was always something creepy about the job-simulator genre.
You turn up for the first day of your new job, meet your colleagues, then take your spot at the departure gate, checking in customers and being careful to root out anyone with invalid tickets.
Then the plane crashes and, frankly, it all goes downhill from there.
